================================================================================
Ambiguous statement keeps the reading chosen without the keyword
================================================================================

foo x y q ;
@ async* ;

---

(source_file
  (statement
    (first
      (identifier))
    (pair)
    (identifier))
  (modifier))

================================================================================
Keyword after the pair
================================================================================

foo x y as ;
@ as b ;

---

(source_file
  (statement
    (first
      (identifier))
    (pair))
  (modifier
    (identifier)))
